Hubble Spots Giant 10-Sided Wave Over Saturn's South Pole

Observations from the Hubble telescope have revealed a large, 10-sided atmospheric wave pattern over Saturn's south pole. Subtle signs of this phenomenon were first traced back to 2023. The wave is embedded within a strong jet stream and spans multiple atmospheric layers. Scientists are studying this evolving feature.
